focus_areas: Link connectivity: Ensure links pass through each other logically without fusion.
Texture realism: Check if the rust texture has realistic micro-details or looks synthetic/repetitive.
Depth coherence: Verify the blur gradient matches the physical distance from the camera lens.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection points of the chain links. AI often fails to render the occlusion correctly, fusing links together or failing to show one passing behind the other. Also, scrutinize the rust texture for repetition patterns.
image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a rusty metal chain resting on a textured wooden surface. The chain consists of thick, oval-shaped links that are heavily oxidized (rusty brown/orange). The focus is sharp on the central links, while the foreground and background blur significantly due to a shallow depth of field. The lighting highlights the rough texture of the rust and the grain of the wood.

expert_testimonies.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a chain and not a similar twisted structure or rope.
